subject: math
question:
设 $f''(x) \in C[a, b]$ ，且 $f(a) = f(b) = 0$ ，证明 $\left|\int_{a}^{b} f(x) \mathrm{d}x\right| \leqslant \frac{(b - a)^3}{12} \max_{a \leqslant x \leqslant b} |f''(x)|$ .

图3.1

steps.text: 分析 $f''(x) \in C[a, b]$ ，知 $\max_{a \leqslant x \leqslant b} |f''(x)|$ 存在。涉及函数的二阶导数，容易想到用泰勒公式将函数放大来得到积分不等式。

方法1 由泰勒公式

$$
f (t) = f (x) + f ^ {\prime} (x) (t - x) + \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi)}{2 !} (t - x) ^ {2} \quad \left(t, x \in [ a, b ], \xi \text {介于} t \text {与} x \text {之间}\right).
$$

所以

$$
\begin{array}{c} 0 = f (a) = f (x) + f ^ {\prime} (x) (a - x) + \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi)}{2 !} (a - x) ^ {2}, \\ f (x) = f ^ {\prime} (x) (x - a) - \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi)}{2 !} (a - x) ^ {2}. \\ \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {a} ^ {b} f ^ {\prime} (x) (x - a) \mathrm{d} x - \int_ {a} ^ {b} \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi)}{2 !} (x - a) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \\ = f (x) (x - a) \Big | _ {a} ^ {b} - \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {a} ^ {b} f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi) (x - a) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x. \end{array}
$$

所以

$$
\int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = - \frac {1}{4} \int_ {a} ^ {b} f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi) (x - a) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x.
$$

于是

$$
\left| \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x \right| \leqslant \frac {1}{4} \int_ {a} ^ {b} \left| f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi) \right| (x - a) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x

\leqslant \frac {1}{4} \max _ {a \leqslant x \leqslant b} | f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) | \int_ {a} ^ {b} (x - a) ^ {2} d x = \frac {(b - a) ^ {3}}{1 2} \max _ {a \leqslant x \leqslant b} | f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) |.
$$

方法2 为了将 $f''(x)$ 引入积分式中，可考虑用分部积分

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\frac {1}{2} \int_ {a} ^ {b} f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) (x - a) (x - b) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {a} ^ {b} (x - a) (x - b) \mathrm{d} f ^ {\prime} (\dot {x})} \\ & {\quad = \frac {1}{2} (x - a) (x - b) \left. f ^ {\prime} (x) \right| _ {a} ^ {b} - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {a} ^ {b} f ^ {\prime} (x) (2 x - a - b) \mathrm{d} x} \\ & {\quad = - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {a} ^ {b} (2 x - a - b) \mathrm{d} f (x) = - \frac {1}{2} f (x) (2 x - a - b) \Big | _ {a} ^ {b} + \frac {1}{2} \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) 2 \mathrm{d} x} \\ & {\quad = \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x.} \end{array}
$$

所以

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \left| \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x \right| & = \left| \frac {1}{2} \int_ {a} ^ {b} f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) (x - a) (x - b) \mathrm{d} x \right| \leqslant \frac {1}{2} \int_ {a} ^ {b} | f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) (x - a) (x - b) | \mathrm{d} x \\ & \leqslant \frac {1}{2} \max _ {a \leqslant x \leqslant b} | f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) | \int_ {a} ^ {b} (x - a) (b - x) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {(b - a) ^ {3}}{1 2} \max _ {a \leqslant x \leqslant b} | f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) |. \end{array}
$$
